request: can you make me a tip calculator? a bill box, buttons for 10%, 15% and 20%, and it shows the tip and the total with cents
design_rationale: A tip calculator is used standing at a table, so one compact card: a bill box, three equal percent buttons and two large figures, neutral base with the amber accent, Inter for clear numbers.

verify.steps: Open the calculator and see Tip: $0.00, enter 50 and press 20% to see a $10.00 tip and $60.00 total, then press 10% to see $5.00 and $55.00.

why.components/TipScreen.jac: The whole screen: heading, Bill box, the three percent buttons and the Tip and Total lines, with the state and handlers.
why.main.jac: Loads global.css and renders the tip screen.

write_reasoning.components/TipScreen.jac: The component owns all state as has fields: the bill text, the tip, the total and an invalid flag. The handlers are plain def because nothing is awaited, and money() always renders two decimals.
write_reasoning.main.jac: Last, main.jac: this app is client-only, so there is no services/ folder and main.jac has no services import. It only loads global.css and returns the tip screen, and one screen needs no router.

plan_call_reasoning: Plan the build: one screen with no saved data, so a single component and no server.
plan_reasoning: One screen: heading, a Bill box, 10%, 15% and 20% buttons and the Tip and Total lines. All state lives in the component as has fields; nothing is saved, so there is no server module. main.jac last.
plan_summary: Build plan written to .jaccoder/build_plan.json: a single-screen client-only tool, 2 files leaf-first, no server, nova/neutral/amber/inter.
journal:
# Agent journal

## Issues
- None so far: the app is client-only, so there are no endpoints to register or await.

## Learnings
- Money is built from whole cents so it always shows two decimals.
- An empty or non-numeric bill shows Enter a bill amount instead of the two lines.

## Last Action
Built TipScreen: a Bill box, 10%, 15% and 20% buttons and the Tip and Total lines.
final:
Tip calculator is running: type a bill, press 10%, 15% or 20%, and it shows the tip and total with two decimals. I checked 50 at 20% gives $10.00 and $60.00, and at 10% gives $5.00 and $55.00.

**Next steps**
- Add a custom percent box
- Split the total between people
- Round the total up

browser.why: The coverage block names the core flow: open the calculator and try two percentages.
Enter the bill and take 20%: a $10.00 tip and a $60.00 total.
Switch to 10%: a $5.00 tip and a $55.00 total.
